profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Web Developer at WSS / Eurostar, Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Senior Full Stack Web Developer | eCommerce
profile.summary: Building Web Application is a passion of mine as well as solving problems and learning new technologies.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer | eCommerce
positions.description:
● Ecommerce Website ( shopwss.com ) – Maintain and add new features using Shopify’s liquid templating language. 

     -	Migrated the website from our previous ecommerce platform to Shopify.

● ShopWSS Mobile Application Android/IOS – Developed and added new features using React Native.

     -	 Built Push Notification system on Shopify platform as a private application using React and Laravel.
  
● Backend System – Developed using LAMP stack to interact with the mobile application and third party platforms ( Shopify, Aptos EOM, Aptos CRM ).

     -	RESTful API that interacts with the ecommerce website, mobile application and the push notification system.
     -	Developed custom scripts to automate daily tasks, including crediting unable-to-fulfill orders, tagging products, synchronizing product data between Shopify and Aptos, and generating Google feed file.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
● ShopWSS Mobile Application - E commerce Android/IOS Application designed for customers to shop, earn reward points, and search for a specific shoe in nearby WSS Stores. 

  - Developed the whole back-end system that interacts with the mobile application and third party platforms (Shopify, Aptos EOM, Aptos CRM).
  - Utilized Azure Server to setup LAMP environment for the back-end system.
  - Developed RESTful API’s and Cron Jobs using Laravel Framework.
  -  Implemented Scan & Find feature using React Native in the front end.

● Ecommerce Websites with Customized themes using Shopify and Wordpress platform.
● Offer prompt and consistent service to better understand client requirements and increase referrals.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Property Management Software
● Made use of Laravel, JQuery, Bootstrap Table, and Elasticsearch indexing clusters to create interactive browser tables and modules.
● Developed custom accounting report creator which allows for dynamic reporting of all the accounting data objects and display the report on the browser or export it in a PDF/CSV format. 
● Developed core property management modules such as Property, Bank, Move Out Process, Eviction Process, and reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Orchestrate development, design, integration, installation, configuration, implementation, updates, and troubleshooting of various programming languages and platform technologies within a development project.

 Selected Projects:
● Ingenlogic Customer Resource Management – oversaw a CRM web-based program specifically designed for Telecommunication Industry, reliably focusing communication between agents and their agencies that work under high-profile service providers like Spectrum/AT&T.

     - crm.ingenlogic.com
     - Developed server-side using Laravel and dynamic user interface with JavaScript and jQuery.
     - Created standalone Web API using PHP for locating fibers and integrated with this program.

● Ingenlogic Backend System – Lead the development of a web-based program designed for Ingenlogic which includes task, client, invoice, commission, expense, and payroll management.

     - Developed server-side using PHP and user interface with JavaScript and jQuery.

● Verizon UW Mobile Application – facilitated the generation of a customer service application specifically designed for Ultimate Wireless stores to provide accurate billing, phone, store and other information for the customers.

     - Sought as a subject matter expert, utilized Ionic 2 framework to develop the entire mobile application with only one code base for all major app stores.
     - Developed RESTful API’s using PHP and effectively consumed them.
     - Integrated MySQL to create and to maintain numerous stored procedures, as well as to design tables with appropriate foreign key relationships.

● JEI Learning Center websites – Personally developed informational websites with web form and center locator.

     - essaycontest.jeilearning.com
     - backtoschool.jeilearning.com
     - Spearheaded efforts for fully responsive web design with a mobile-first approach.
     - Developed RESTful API using PHP for a comprehensive list of centers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Offered essential contributions in supporting Client Administration and Reporting Tool (CART), a SaaS product that enabled hospital administrators, medical personnel, social workers and third-party healthcare agencies to collect, share, and analyze complex information related to emergency room visits.
● Implemented key full-stack features, including RESTful APIs with C# and ASP.NET Web API 2, server-side views with C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, and dynamic user interface with JQuery and AngularJS.

● Interacted with Google Maps API over Ajax to dependably perform geocoding lookups and present geographical information with clear, actionable map visualization.

company.name: SoCapTech: Client Administration and Reporting Tool (CART)
